name: AML/CFT compliance kit for small obliged entities (real estate agents, accountants and bookkeeping agencies, small notary and law offices): risk assessment, internal procedures, client ID file, authorised-person log, 5-year record retention, FOO reporting helper
buyer: Small real estate agencies and brokers, bookkeeping/accounting firms, solo lawyers and notary offices across FBiH, RS and Brcko
trigger: State AML/CFT Law Sl. glasnik BiH 13/2024; implementing rulebook adopted by the Council of Ministers (reported 5 Jan 2026); FATF/MONEYVAL observation period from Feb 2025 with grey-list risk; guide for real estate dealers published Mar 2026 on fuzip.gov.ba
evidence: https://fuzip.gov.ba/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Vodic-za-trgovce-nekretninama_ZA-WEB.pdf (read locally via PDF text: mentions 30,000 KM transactions and cash restrictions; exact thresholds unverified); https://www.paragraf.ba/dnevne-vijesti/05012026/05012026-vijest4.html ; https://www.eeas.europa.eu/delegations/bosnia-and-herzegovina/stav-eu-u-bih-po-pitanju-potrebe-hitnog-djelovanja-na-otklanjanju-nedostataka-u-sistemu-u-bih-za_bs ; https://unija.com/bs/uloga-racunovodje-u-sprjecavanju-pranja-novca/ ; https://advokat-prnjavorac.com:8443/zakoni/Zakon-o-sprecavanju-pranja-novca-i-finansiranja-teroristickih-aktivnosti-BiH-2024.pdf
existing: Competitor search (Bosnian: program/softver sprječavanje pranja novca obveznik BiH) found no local AML software vendor or price list; only legal texts, a consultancy article (unija.com) and paid seminars (Paragraf Lex, Oct 2026). Regional AML/KYC tools were not checked.
unchecked: Exact obligations by obliged-entity type; the supervisory body and inspection or fine activity per entity; whether the 2026 rulebook sets forms or electronic filing to FOO; regional AML vendors selling into BiH; size of the population (agencies, accountants); willingness to pay.

first_check.market: FBiH has 135 registered real estate agencies with 177 certified agents (Federal Ministry of Trade register, as quoted by prostor.ba, undated). Around 2022 the FBiH Chamber estimated about 150 legal brokers and many unregistered ones. I found no count of accounting or bookkeeping firms, or of RS and Brcko agencies. Bookkeeping agencies are likely the bigger segment, plausibly low thousands nationwide, but this is unverified. Auditors, gambling operators and dealers in vehicles and precious goods are also obliged entities and could be added.
first_check.reason: The duty is real and being enforced now. The state AML/CFT law (Sl. glasnik BiH 13/2024) Art. 5 lists bookkeeping, accounting and tax firms, auditors, real estate intermediaries, lawyers and notaries as obliged entities. They must keep a documented risk assessment updated at least yearly and sent to the supervisor (Art. 10), keep internal procedures, appoint an authorised person and deputy, run client ID checks and report to the FIU. The implementing rulebook was published in Feb 2026 and gave 90 days to align. FUZIP market inspectors began special AML checks on 28 Sep 2026, running to end-2026, with fines of 5,000-200,000 KM. I found no local or regional SMB AML tool, only UK tools (Credas, Thirdfort, FigsFlow, Xama) and Asseco's bank-grade system. The market is small: 135 agencies in FBiH, and accountant counts were not found.

challenge_check.killer: None found. Gaps not settled: the FOO electronic STR/CTR reporting channel, local consultancies selling templates (I found none with prices), and the number of obliged entities.
challenge_check.reason: I found nothing that kills it. Bosnian, Serbian and Croatian searches turned up no local or regional AML software, model-act generator or free state tool for small non-financial obliged entities. Asseco's AML product is built for banks, and UK tools (FigsFlow, SmartSearch) have no BiH forms. Enforcement is real: in January 2026 the RS Inspectorate gave randomly chosen accountants, bookkeepers and tax advisers 10 days to submit internal acts, a 13-item questionnaire and a checklist, with fines up to 200,000 KM. That burden on sole traders drew public complaints. RS notaries also got risk-assessment guidelines in January 2026. Against it: BiH is a small market, buyers are price-sensitive, and the core need is a one-off document set that consultants can sell. Not checked: whether the FOO has an electronic reporting portal, and how many entities there are.
